items.title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 hands over full control to artists to 'direct the final frame'
items.excerpt: A SIGGRAPH technical demo shows DLSS 5's neural rendering pipeline handing artists control to 'direct the final frame,' using a one-step pixel-space diffusion transform to reach 4K, life-like visuals on a single GPU. A craft shift: AI upscaling moves from a black box to a directable creative tool in the art pipeline.

items.title: Unity unveils Unity 7 roadmap with an update path that won't break your build
items.excerpt: Unity's Unity 7 roadmap adds a CLI/public API and a free MCP server that wires coding agents directly into the engine, so creators and AI agents can validate assets, push builds, and collaborate side by side — framed as optional, with no breaking changes from Unity 6.

items.title: 'It creates lesser games': Indie studios are supposed to love generative AI, so why do the 25 devs I spoke to avoid it?
items.excerpt: Indie studios are supposedly the natural adopters of generative AI, yet 25 developers explain why they keep it out of their craft — arguing the tools 'create lesser games' and erode the hand-made quality players can feel. A grounded look at why the workflow promise isn't landing with small teams.

items.title: Half of all games released on Steam will use AI by 2028, study predicts: 'AI lowers the barrier not just to make a game but to make several'
items.excerpt: A census of 53,000+ Steam titles finds AI-flagged releases jumped from 10.9% (2024) to 30.8% (2026) and projects half of all Steam games will use AI by 2028, as generative tooling lowers the barrier to shipping several games at once — reshaping the economics designers compete inside.

items.title: All The Video Game Studios That Refuse To Use Generative AI
items.excerpt: A running roll-call of game studios publicly pledging to keep generative AI out of their development, with devs framing it as a craft-and-values stance — 'ownership of the work has to be traceable' and 'AI art will never match sentient creation' — a counterweight to the industry's AI-adoption push.
